name: @luxwallet/monorepo
description: Lux Wallet — the one native, omnichain, post-quantum wallet stack. Headless @luxwallet/core + chains/rpc/connect leaves + mpc/safe/bridge custody seams.

scripts.build: tsc --build packages/chains packages/rpc packages/connect packages/core packages/mpc packages/safe packages/bridge
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build packages/chains packages/rpc packages/connect packages/core packages/mpc packages/safe packages/bridge
scripts.clean: tsc --build --clean packages/chains packages/rpc packages/connect packages/core packages/mpc packages/safe packages/bridge
